chunks: And boys of everlasting youth will go about attending them. Looking at them you would think that they were pearls dispersed.

key_terms.مُخَلَّدُونَ: Eternal, those who do not die

ai.seo_question: Who are the eternal boys serving in Paradise according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'mukhalladun' signifies their eternal youth and immortality, distinguishing them from the transient nature of worldly servants. The simile of 'scattered pearls' (lu'lu'un manthur) highlights their uniform brilliance and purity, often interpreted as a reflection of the spiritual light (nur) that accompanies the righteous in the afterlife. This imagery serves to comfort believers by describing the refined, eternal service that enhances the bliss of Paradise.
